image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), stands on snowy ground scattered with twigs and debris. The bird exhibits non-breeding plumage with a brownish-grey head featuring dark streaks, an orange-rufous breast fading to white on the belly, and brown upperparts with black wings displaying distinct white bars. The bill is short, conical, and yellowish-grey. The legs are pinkish-brown and slender.

To detect subtle texture anomalies, melting, or AI-generated 'smearing' in the complex feather patterns against the snow background.
